summary: OMCL is a solvency-clean, governance-clean name suffering operational decline. The -60.7% drawdown reflects real and ACCELERATING product-revenue contraction (-22% FY23, -28% Q1 2024 YoY) plus $575M Sep-2025 convertible notes that will require refinancing with stock 67%+ below conversion price. But: $512M cash, $350M undrawn revolver, covenant compliance, Deloitte 10-year tenure with clean ICFR, no going-concern flags, no insider selling during drawdown (17 Form 4s, codes A/F only — zero open-market sells), and Advanced Services backlog +27% (subscription pivot real in the data, not just narrative). The strongest Mode B finding is the Q1 2024 product-revenue acceleration of decline contradicting management's stabilization framing; the strongest Mode A pass is insider behavior. This is NOT a liar — it is honest distress with a known refinancing event. The 0.125-style framework should NOT score this as a SHORT candidate.
